scope: Casualty point identity when native source/group retention is absent
finding: Point START required a non-null native corpse and its current group to equal the observer group. The reference body-check uses position-based corpse discovery; CBE needed original affiliation evidence without a global allDeadMen scan. Actual runtime frequency of missing source/detachment is not measured.
implementation: Existing owner-local EntityKilled intake records at most eight body identities with original five-minute server expiries, independently of survivor-regroup enable. Duplicate bodies retain original expiry. No new handler or worker.
Point START evaluates cheap actor/feature/route/cooldown guards before bounded read-only identity resolution. A valid explicit dead own-group source takes priority.

Without a valid explicit source, exactly one recent recorded casualty within3m of a fresh native own-group casualty observation may corroborate identity even after group detachment. Ambiguous, expired, missing, living or hidden bodies refuse. No world-object query.

Death records never dispatch movement or manufacture hostile knowledge; the later native cause5 observation remains the engine trigger. Current body position samples establish actual movement coordinates.

Body hiding cancels an admitted approach; normal stop clears group history. Public identity receipts survive owner transfer without replaying movement or extending expiry. Existing point deadlines/acknowledgement/native-order cleanup remain unchanged.
engineEvidenceLimit: Documentation describes actual killed-entity callback, not corpse group lifetime or observed source reliability in this scenario. Those remain live retest items.

remaining: Actual group availability at EntityKilled and source/group retention timing unverified.
Deaths while runtime was off, deleted original groups and casualties older than five minutes have no retrospective affiliation recovery.
Multiple coincident bodies without an explicit valid source remain ambiguous.
Native approach/visit, repeated encounters, normal/HC/JIP and runtime overhead still require physical measurement.
